explanation: Sushi refers to the vinegared rice, and the name comes from an old word for sour. Raw fish served on its own, without rice, is sashimi.

claims.text: Sushi does not mean 'raw fish'; the word refers to dishes of vinegared rice.
The word sushi comes from an old Japanese word meaning sour.
Sliced raw fish served without rice is called sashimi.
